Yunnan Germanium.why: InP substrate maker whose InP wafer demand and prices are rising with AI data-center optical communications (lasers and detectors); capacity expanding to 45 ten-thousand wafers/year (4-inch equivalent)
Yunnan Germanium.evidence: Yunnan Germanium IR activity record: 2026-009 (09-04-2026): compound-semiconductor demand rose sharply in H1 2026 on AI computing and data centers, with InP wafers for optical communications growing fastest; InP wafer customers are mainly epitaxy makers and device makers with their own epitaxy

players.product: Indium phosphide (InP) wafers (2-4 inch) for optical-communication lasers and detectors, made by subsidiary Yunnan Xinyao Semiconductor Materials; also gallium arsenide wafers and germanium products (germanium ingots, germanium tetrachloride for optical fiber, solar germanium wafers, infrared optics)

quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): current capacities - germanium ingots 47.60 tonnes/year; solar germanium wafers 125 ten-thousand wafers/year (4-inch equivalent); germanium tetrachloride for optical fiber 60 tonnes/year; infrared germanium lenses 3.55 ten-thousand sets/year; gallium arsenide wafers 80 ten-thousand wafers/year (2-6 inch); indium phosphide wafers 15 ten-thousand wafers/year (2-4 inch).
quarterly_data.figure: Ge ingots 47.60 t/yr; solar Ge wafers 125 ten-thousand/yr; GeCl4 60 t/yr; IR lenses 3.55 ten-thousand sets/yr; GaAs wafers 80 ten-thousand/yr; InP wafers 15 ten-thousand/yr

quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): for the InP expansion project, some equipment has already moved in for installation and commissioning; customization, purchasing and delivery of the equipment are proceeding on plan with no bottleneck. InP wafer yield is still improving steadily, and rising yield is an important driver of continuously falling manufacturing cost. The company has no current plan to extend InP downstream.

Management (IR record): gallium arsenide is being upgraded - in November 2025 the company set up Hubei Xinyao to run a 'high-quality GaAs wafer' project (18-month construction) that relocates the existing GaAs line to a new plant and builds a 70 ten-thousand wafers/year 6-inch GaAs wafer line plus a 3 ten-thousand sets/year 4-6 inch semiconductor-grade quartz tube line; construction is on plan.
quarterly_data.figure: 70 ten-thousand 6-inch GaAs wafers/year; 3 ten-thousand quartz tube sets/year

quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): H1 2026 sales volume and revenue of both fiber-grade and PV-grade germanium products fell year on year, after the company changed their pricing to pass through raw-material cost and new-order negotiations lengthened.
